This demo version was created so you can get acquainted with the game’s world, its atmosphere, and the first mechanics. The content here is limited, and some elements will still be refined and changed as the project develops.

If you enjoyed it, we’d be glad to hear your feedback. It truly helps us move in the right direction. This is only the beginning of the journey—many discoveries lie ahead.

Add Windrose to your wishlist and drop by our Discord—it's where a community of brave sea wolves and the development team come together.

Thank you for your support and for being with us! 
 
You’re playing Windrose during its Early Access stage — the game is still actively evolving. Bugs, rough edges, and changes to mechanics are to be expected. Not everything is perfect yet, but we believe that creating a truly great game is only possible together with you. We carefully read your feedback and do our best to take it into account as development continues. Your support means a great deal to us.

The sea is already calling, and the adventure is only gaining momentum. Follow updates on the store page and join our Discord to stay connected with us and with other captains.

The Connection Service handles two things: registering invite codes for dedicated servers and providing server information to clients (such as IP address, port, and routing points).

<T_BOLD>In simple terms, all players in a co-op session need access to at least one shared Connection Service.</> If one player doesn’t have access to the same service as the others, they won’t be able to connect together.

It’s recommended to use a Connection Service that’s geographically close to you. Keep in mind this service only handles the initial handshake between your game client and the dedicated server, so it does not affect your in-game ping.

If all Connection Services appear unavailable, the only way to connect with your friends is by using Direct IP connection.

Sometimes players are unable to connect directly to their friends’ games because P2P traffic is blocked along the route. This can happen for many reasons, such as router settings, ISP restrictions, firewall restrictions, and more. Enabling this option will route your traffic through a special relay service, which may help bypass these restrictions.
 
<T_NEG>Please note that enabling this option may increase your ping.</>
